global_limitations: All geometries and crop spacing profiles are synthetic.
Uniform grid is finite and does not prove continuous optimum.
BnB node upper bound uses platform libm trigonometric intervals; it is not a formal numerical certificate.
Phase arrangement is fixed-orientation only, capped at 600 boundary fragments and uses floating-point topology.

The rational Steiner bound certifies an integer upper bound for the ideal lattice family over the represented polygon vertices; candidate feasibility remains numerical, so no continuous optimum certificate is issued.
Extreme absolute coordinate offsets are rejected when floating-point ULP exceeds geometric tolerance.
Candidate locations are not agronomically approved or field validated.
